g.text: Temperature follows a strong annual cycle (daily means from -7 °C to 29 °C); the wettest 10 minutes (26.7 mm, 17 Aug 2024 14:40 UTC) came with a sharp temperature drop.
Data: GeoSphere Austria, klima-v2-10min, station 105 (CC BY 4.0).
263,088 10-minute records loaded. Shaded band in the overview marks the period shown in the detail tracks.
